text: Debugging is an important skill for every programmer. When your code does not work, the first step is identifying bugs. You need to find where the problem is and what causes it. Many developers use debugging tools, such as breakpoints, to stop the program and check the values of variables. A systematic approach is also helpful. Instead of guessing, you should test one part at a time and make small changes. Another useful method is logging. By adding print statements or log messages, you can see what happens while the program runs. With patience and practice, debugging becomes much easier.
